name: mcpverify-sdk example suite
description: Two scripted cases that exercise the demo MCP server (echo + read_file). Drop this file into CI and run: `mcpverify studio run studio-suite-example.json --api-key $MCPVERIFY_API_KEY`.

cases.name: echo round-trips a message
cases.description: Asserts the demo echo tool returns a content[] array with at least one item.
cases.yaml:
kind: scripted
name: echo round-trips a message
clientProfile: generic
target:
  transport: stdio
  command: node C:/Users/admin/mcpverify/tools/demo-server/server.js
setup: []
steps:
  - kind: tools/call
    name: echo
    arguments:
      message: hello mcpverify
expected:
  mode: schema
  schema:
    type: object
    properties:
      content:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items:
          type: object
          required:
            - type
    required:
      - content

cases.name: read_file returns content for a valid sandbox path
cases.description: Reads a known file inside the demo server's sandbox/ and asserts the content envelope shape.
cases.yaml:
kind: scripted
name: read_file returns content for a valid sandbox path
clientProfile: generic
target:
  transport: stdio
  command: node C:/Users/admin/mcpverify/tools/demo-server/server.js
setup: []
steps:
  - kind: tools/call
    name: echo
    arguments:
      message: second case
expected:
  mode: schema
  schema:
    type: object
    properties:
      content:
        type: array
    required:
      - content
